blogs.title: Tasty Udon Chicken Noodles Soup Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी उडोन चिकन नूडल्स सूप रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Delicious hot and sour chicken soup with those thick udon noodles. It is so filling and is so delicious too. You can enjoy this soup on cold days.

 

Udon Chicken Noodles Soup Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 25 mins

 

Recipe type: Soup

Cuisine: Chinese

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Udon Noodles - 100 grams

Chicken with Bones - 500 grams

Carrot - 1 grated

Cabbage - 1 cup chopped finely

Soya Sauce - 2 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Sugar - 1 teaspoon

Vinegar to taste

Cornflour / Cornstarch - 1 tablespoon

Black Pepper to taste

 

Instructions

Cook udon noodles as per package directions. Drain them and divide it between serving bowls.

Take chicken in a pot, cover with water and cook till chicken is tender.

Now drain the chicken and remove flesh from it.

Now add carrot and cabbage to the chicken and cook till the veggies are done.

Add salt, soy sauce, sugar, pepper, and vinegar.

Add in cornflour mixed with little water. Mix well so the soup gets thick.

Now Pour the soup over the noodles and serve.

blogs.title: Tasty Baked Baked Murgh ( Chicken ) Badami Kebab Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी बेक्ड बेक्ड मुरग (चिकन) बादामी कबाब रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Delicious badam chicken which is baked to perfection and is finger-licking good. This not only tastes amazing but is super succulent.

 

Baked Badam Chicken Kebab Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 6 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 1 kg cut into pieces

Badam - 50 grams

Cream - ¼ cup

Kasuri methi leaves - 2 tablespoon

Green chilies - 6

Mint leaves - 1 cup

Coriander leaves - 1 cup

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoon

Curd / Yogurt - ¼ cup

Salt to taste

Black Pepper to taste

Lemon Juice - 4 tablespoon

Oil - ¼ cup

 

Instructions

Make deep slashes on chicken.

Grind all ingredients together to a smooth paste

Pour over chicken and mix well. Leave to marinate for at least 4 hours or overnight.

Arrange in a baking tray and bake for 45 mins. Flip in between and continue baking,

Serve it hot.

blogs.title: Homemade Chicken Pot Pie Recipe
blogs.title_hi: घर का बना चिकन पॉट पाई पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
This is a delicious chicken pot pie that tastes amazing for either a light lunch or dinner. This is so much easier and simple to make at home and kids will love it.

 

Chicken Pot Pie Recipe - Homemade Chicken Pie From Scratch

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 1 hour

Total time: 1 hour 10 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Greece

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

 

FOR PASTRY:

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 1 cup

Cold Butter - 50 grams cubed

Salt to taste

Cold Water as needed

 

FOR CHICKEN:

Butter - 1 tablespoon

Oil - 1 tablespoon

Boneless Chicken - 500 grams

Dried Rosemary - 1 teaspoon

Cayenne Powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 2 tablespoon

 

FOR FILLING:

Butter - 2 tablespoon

Garlic - 1 tablespoon minced

Onion - 1 chopped finely

Carrot - 1 chopped finely

Bell Pepper - 1 chopped finely

Salt to taste

Black Pepper to taste

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 2 tablespoon

Milk - 2 cups

Frozen Peas - ½ cup

Chopped Parsley or Coriander - 2 tablespoon

 

Instructions

Make pastry dough. Take flour in a bowl. Add salt and mix well.

Add in butter and rub it into the flour. Add cold water and shape it into a dough. Chill in the fridge for 1 hour.

Mix chicken with rosemary, salt, all-purpose flour, and cayenne.

Heat oil and butter in a pan, fry chicken till golden brown. Remove and set aside.

Heat more butter in the same pan, add garlic, onion, carrot, and peppers. Saute for a min.

Add in flour, salt, pepper and mix well.

Add milk and mix well.

Add in chicken and frozen peas and simmer for 10 to 15 mins.

Add chopped parsley and mix well.

Now cool this mix. Preheat oven to 200 degrees C.

Take a portion of the dough and roll it into a sheet.

Spoon it into individual pan and top with the rolled pastry sheet,'Make holes in the top. seal the edges.

Pop it in the oven and bake for 25 to 30 mins till golden.

Remove and serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Majestic ( Masala Coated ) Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी चिकन मैजेस्टिक (मसाला कोटेड) रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Delicious chicken majestic which is Hyderabadi famous street food. This tastes amazing on its own or as a side dish for rice.

 

Chicken Majestic Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Appetizer

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Boneless Chicken - 500 grams

Curd or Plain Yogurt - 3 tablespoon

Ginger Garlic Paste - 1 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Egg - 1

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 3 tablespoon

Cornflour - 3 tablespoon

Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Pepper Powder - 1 teaspoon

Cumin Powder - 1 teaspoon

Garam masala powder - 1 teaspoon

Turmeric powder - ½ teaspoon

Oil for pan-frying

 

FOR MASALA:

Oil - 1 tablespoon

Curry leaves a handful

Garlic Paste - 1 teaspoon

Green Chillies - 2 chopped

Chilli Powder - 1 teaspoon

Garam Masala powder - 1 teaspoon

Turmeric powder - ½ teaspoon

Curd / Plain Yogurt - 2 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Soy Sauce - to taste

Black Pepper powder - 1 teaspoon

 

Instructions

Mix chicken with salt and yogurt and leave to marinate for 30 mins to overnight.

Add all the ingredients. Marinate chicken with all things listed for marination.

Heat oil for pan-frying. Drop chicken and fry till golden.

Drain and set aside.

Heat oil in a pan. Add garlic, curry leaves, and chilies and saute.

Add spice powders and curd. Mix well.,

Add fried chicken and mix well. Add pepper powder and soy sauce.

Serve it hot.

blogs.title: Tasty Vepudu Guntur Chicken Curry Recipe
blogs.title_hi: तास्ति रोस्ट गुंटूर चिकन करी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Delicious and juicy chicken stir fry which is also called chicken vepudu. This is super yummy and tastes amazing with some rice and rasam.

This is a spicy chicken dish that tastes fantastic. It is spicy and delicious. This tastes amazing even with some pulao, biryani as well. You can even serve it with some roti or paratha too. But I enjoy it thoroughly with some rasam rice.

 

Vepudu Guntur Chicken Curry

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

 

FOR CHICKEN:

Chicken - 500 grams with bone

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Coriander Powder - 1 teaspoon

Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Cumin powder - 1 teaspoon

Garam masala powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Lemon Juice - 3 tablespoons

Oil for deep frying

 

FOR MASALA:

Oil - 2 tablespoons

Onion - 1 large sliced

Curry Leaves a handful

Ginger Garlic Paste - 1 tablespoon

Tomato - 2 chopped

Salt to taste

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Coriander Powder - 1 teaspoon

Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Cumin powder - 1 teaspoon

Garam masala powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Water - 1 cup

 

Instructions

Take chicken in a bowl, add all ingredients except oil and mix well.

Deep fry chicken till golden. Drain and set aside.

Heat little oil in a pan. Add in onion, curry leaves, ginger garlic paste and mix well.

Add tomatoes and mix well.

Add salt, spice powders, water and mix well.

Once the gravy is done. Add chicken and mix well.

Cover and cook till chicken is dry.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Kongunadu Kozhi Kuzhambu ( Kongu Style ) Chicken Curry Recipe
blogs.title_hi: तस्सती कोंगुनाडु कोजही कुजाम्बु (कोंगु स्टाइल) चिकन करी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Super spicy and fragrant chicken curry made kongu style with fresh spice powder and potato. This is not only easy to make but taste amazing.

This is a spicy chicken dish that tastes fantastic. It is spicy and delicious. This tastes amazing even with some pulao, biryani as well. You can even serve it with some roti or paratha too. But I enjoy it thoroughly with some rasam rice.

 

Kongunadu Kozhi Kuzhambu Recipe

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

 

FOR THE SPICE MIX

Dry Red Chillies - 100 grams

Coriander Seeds - 300 grams

Cumin Seeds - 25 grams

Black Pepper - 25 grams

 

FOR CURRY:

Gingelly Oil - ¼ cup

Fennel Seeds / Sombu - 1 tsp

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 small stick

Cardamom / Yelakai - 3

Cloves / Krambu - 3

Onion - 1 large sliced thinly

Green Chillies - 2

Ginger Garlic Paste - 1 tablespoon

Tomato - 2 chopped finely

Kuzhambu Milagai Thool - 3 to 4 tablespoon (recipe above)

Salt to taste

Chicken - ½ kg

Potato - 1 large peeled and cubed

Water as needed

 

Instructions

Sundry the spices for a day and grind it in a blender till fine. Set aside.

Heat oil in a pan. Add whole spices and let them sizzle.

Add onions, chilies and saute till light brown.

Add ginger-garlic paste and saute till raw smell leaves.

Add in tomatoes and cook till mushy.

Add in spice powders and salt and mix well.

Add in chicken and mix well.

Add water. Cover and cook for 20 mins.

Add potatoes and cook for another 15 mins.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Sesame Chicken Noodles Recipe

blogs.content:
Delicious chicken noodles made with a touch of sesame flavor. It tastes so delicious and is so fast to make as well.

 

Sesame Chicken Noodles Recipe

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Chinese

Ingredients

blogs.title: Tasty Stir-fried Chicken in Black Bean and Black Pepper Sauce Recipe
blogs.title_hi: ब्लैक बीन और काली मिर्च सॉस सॉस में टेस्टी स्टिर-फ्राइड चिकन
blogs.content:
Delicious chicken cooked in a spicy black bean and pepper sauce. This tastes amazing with noodles or fried rice. It is not only delicious but fast to make as well.

When I was looking for dinner inspiration online, I came across a picture of a spicy chicken served with some noodles. I got so inspired by that so I made it almost immediately.

This chicken dish is so easy to make, you need basic ingredients. If you use small chicken pieces then it will be tastier.

 

Stir Fry Chicken in Black Bean & Black Pepper Sauce

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Chinese

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

For Chicken:-

Boneless Chicken - 500 grams cut into small pieces

Soy Sauce - 2 teaspoons

Vinegar - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Sugar - ¼ teaspoon

Cornflour - 2 tablespoon

Oil - 4 tablespoon

 

For Sauce:-

Oil - 1 tablespoon

Ginger - 1 teaspoon chopped

Onion - 1 chopped

Spring Onion - 1 chopped

Black Bean Sauce - 2 tablespoon

Water as needed

Black pepper powder to taste

 

Instructions

Mix chicken with all ingredients.

Heat oil in a pan. Add in chicken and saute till golden.

Remove it to a plate.

Heat oil in a pan. Add ginger, onions and spring onion.

Add in sauce and saute for a min.

Add in water and mix well.

Add chicken back in and cover. Cook for 5 to 8 mins.

Add in pepper powder and mix well.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken in Yogurt Sauce Recipe
blogs.title_hi: दही सॉस में टेस्टी चिकन
blogs.content:
Dahi chicken is very easy to make. This goes well with pulao or roti. This tastes amazing and is easy to make.

 

Chicken in Yogurt Sauce

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 3 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - ½ kg

Yogurt / Curd - ¾ cup

Chilli powder - 1 tablespoon

Kashmiri chili powder - 1 tablespoon

Cumin Powder - 1 teaspoon

Coriander Powder - 1 tablespoon

Turmeric Powder - ½ teaspoon

Pepper Powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Garam Masala Powder - 1 tablespoon

Ginger Garlic Paste - 1 tablespoon

Ghee - 1 teaspoon

Cumin Seeds - 1 teaspoon

Kasuri methi leaves - 2 tablespoon

Coriander leaves - a handful finely chopped

 

Instructions

Mix chicken with yogurt and spices. Leave to marinate for 30 mins.

Heat ghee in a pan, add in cumin seeds and let them sizzle.

Add chicken and mix well for 5 mins.

Now add in little water. Cover and cook chicken for 20 to 25 mins.

Once the chicken is cooked, add in Kasuri methi leaves and coriander leaves.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Couscous  With Sumac Chicken And Butter Mushrooms Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट चिकन और मक्खन मशरूम पकाने की विधि के साथ स्वादिष्ट
blogs.content:
This is a Moroccan themed lunch made using couscous and chicken. This is not only easy to make but taste amazing.

 

Couscous with Sumac Chicken and Mushrooms

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Morocco

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Couscous - 1 cup

Sultanas - ¼ cup

Cayenne Powder - 1 tsp

Cumin Powder - 1 tsp

Salt to taste

Hot Water - 2 cups

 

FOR CHICKEN:

Chicken Breast - 2

Cayenne Powder - 1 teaspoon

salt to taste

Sumac Powder - 2 teaspoons

Black Pepper to taste

Lemon Juice as needed

Olive Oil - 2 tablespoons

FOR MUSHROOMS:

Butter - 1 tablespoon

Garlic - 3 cloves chopped

Mushrooms - 1 cup chopped

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

Instructions

Marinate chicken with the ingredients given for 2 hours.

Mix couscous with all ingredients in a bowl. Pour over hot water, cover and cook for 15 mins till all water is absorbed. Set aside.

Heat butter in a pan, add garlic and stir fry for a min,

Add in mushrooms and mix well.

Season with salt and pepper. Cook till brown and set aside.

Now in the same pan, place chicken and cook for 5 to 6 mins on each side. Add little water and cook covered for 10 mins on low heat.

Serve over couscous.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Burger Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट चिकन बर्गर पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
The delicious and juicy chicken burger which is not only tasty but is super easy to make. This burger makes a great lunch or dinner.

The super delicious spicy burger which is perfect to pack in a lunch box or taste amazing for dinner too.

 

Chicken Burger Recipe

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 10 mins

Total time: 20 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 burger

 

Ingredients

Minced Chicken - 500 grams

Olive oil - 1 tablespoon + more for frying

Onion - 1 small chopped finely

Capsicum / Bell Pepper - ¼ cup chopped finely

Garlic - 3 chopped finely

Green Chillies - 1 chopped finely

Egg - 1

Breadcrumbs - ½ cup

Salt to taste

Black Pepper to taste

Coriander Leaves - ½ cup chopped finely

Mayonnaise as needed

Tomato Ketchup as needed

Onions - 1 sliced

Tomato - 1 sliced

Burger Buns as needed

 

Instructions

Heat oil in a pan, add onions, capsicum, chilies, garlic and saute for a min.

Take chicken in a bowl, add all ingredients except oil and mix well.

Shape it into a ball and flatten it into patties.

Heat oil in a pan, add in patties and cook for 3 to 4 mins on each side.

Take burger buns, split open, spread mayo and ketchup.

Place patties and top with sliced onions and tomatoes.

blogs.title: Tasty Broasted Chicken Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी ब्रॉस्टेड चिकन रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Broasted chicken is easy to make. This fried chicken recipe is so perfect which gives you a similar one to KFC fried chicken and it tastes amazing with garlic sauce.

 

Broasted Chicken Recipe - Chicken Broast Recipe

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 10 mins

Total time: 20 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 6 servings

 

Ingredients

Oil for deep frying

 

FOR CHICKEN:

Chicken with skin and bones - 1 whole chicken cut into 12 pieces

Salt to taste

Black Pepper to taste

Lemon Juice or vinegar - 1 tablespoon

FOR FLOUR COATING:

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 2 cups

Cornflour - ¾ cup

Garlic powder - 2 tablespoons

Dried Parsley - 1 tablespoon

Dried Oregano - 2 tablespoons

Dried Basil - 1 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Black Pepper - 2 teaspoon

Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

FOR EGG:

Egg - 2

Water - ¼ cup

Salt to taste

 

Instructions

Mix chicken with salt, pepper, and vinegar and set aside.

Take flour in a bowl along with all ingredients given together. Set aside.

Take an egg, salt, water in a bowl and whisk well.

Now take chicken, coat in flour, then dip in egg and then coat in flour. Pack it well.

Set aside in a plate to dry for 5 mins.

Heat oil in a pressure cooker, drop the chicken in and fry for 30 seconds to 45 seconds.

Cover the cooker and pressure cook for 1 or 2 whistles.

Now switch off the flame and let it sit for 5 mins.

Now release the pressure carefully by lifting the whistle with a spoon.

Now open the cooker, and heat it again and fry till the outer layer gets crispy again.

Now drain it and serve hot.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Uppu Kari ( Dozhu Uppukari ) Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट चिकन उप्पू कारी ( दोझू उप्पूकारी ) रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Chicken uppu kari or Kozhi Uppu kari is an easy and tasty side dish which can be made in a few mins. It needs just basic ingredients and tastes amazing.

 

Chicken Uppu Kari Recipe

 

Prep time: 5 mins

Cook time: 40 mins

Total time: 45 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 500 grams cut into small pieces

Ginger Garlic Paste - 1 tablespoon + 1 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Garam masala powder - 2 teaspoon

Turmeric powder - 1 teaspoon

Coconut Oil - 4 tablespoon

Dry Red Chilli - 5 broken

Curry Leaves - a handful

Onion - 1 chopped

Pepper powder - 1 tablespoon

Coriander leaves - ¼ cup chopped

 

Instructions

Take chicken, salt, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, chilli and garam masala powder in a pan. Add little water and cook till chicken is done.

Heat coconut oil in a pan, add in curry leaves, dry red chillies and fry for a min.

Add onions and ginger-garlic paste and mix well.

Add chicken and toss well. Cook for 5 to 7 mins.

Add in pepper powder and mix well. Finally, add coriander leaves too.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Pita Bread Salad Bowl Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट पाव रोटी ब्रेड सलाद बाउल रेसिपी
blogs.content:
This pita bread salad bowl is filling and tastes amazing. It has all the elements you need. The pita bread is crunchy and the veggies are fresh and the sauce is tangy.

 

Pita Bread Salad Bowl Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 10 mins

Total time: 20 mins

 

Recipe type: Salad

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Pita bread - 2

Onion - 1 sliced

Cooked Chicken - ½ cup

Tomato - 1 deseeded and chopped

Cucumber - 1 chopped

 

FOR SAUCE:

Mayonnaise - ¼ cup

Yogurt - ¼ cup

Garlic - 2 teaspoons grated

Salt to taste

Cumin Powder - 1 teaspoon

Pepper Powder - ½ teaspoon

 

Instructions

Mix all sauce ingredients. Set aside in the fridge till needed.

Take pita bread. Cut into triangles. Pop that in a baking sheet and bake in a 150 degree C oven for 12 to 15 mins till it is golden. Set aside to cool.

Now take the pita chips in a bowl, top with onions, cooked chicken, tomatoes and cucumber and pour some sauce on top.

Serve immediately.
